subject: spanish
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.explain: 'Navegar por internet' means 'to surf/browse the internet'.

questions.q: How do you say “I spend too much time online”?
questions.explain: “Paso demasiado tiempo en línea” = “I spend too much time online”.

questions.q: How do you say 'I like playing the guitar'?
questions.explain: Instruments use 'tocar' (not 'jugar'); 'me gusta' + infinitive, so 'Me gusta tocar la guitarra'.

questions.q: How do you say 'I spend too much time on my mobile'?
options: Paso demasiado tiempo en el móvil
Paso poco tiempo en el móvil
Paso demasiado tiempo en el ordenador
Gasto demasiado dinero en el móvil
questions.explain: 'Pasar tiempo' = 'to spend time' (use 'gastar' only for money); 'demasiado' = 'too much'.
“El tiempo libre” means “free time / leisure time”.
“Navegar por internet” is the idiom “to surf/browse the internet”.
“La batería” is the “drum kit”, so “tocar la batería” = “to play the drums”.
“El ciberacoso” means “cyberbullying” (online harassment).
“La contraseña” means “the password”.

questions.q: How do you say “I prefer subtitles to dubbing”?
options: Prefiero el doblaje a los subtítulos
Prefiero los subtítulos a la pantalla
questions.explain: “Los subtítulos” = subtitles and “el doblaje” = dubbing: “Prefiero los subtítulos al doblaje”.

questions.q: Which sentence means “The internet keeps me informed”?
questions.explain: “Mantener informado” = “to keep informed”, so “Internet me mantiene informado”.
“Dar un paseo” means “to go for a walk/stroll”.
'El éxito' is a false friend: it means 'success', not 'exit' (which is 'la salida').

questions.q: How do you say “I download apps onto my phone”?
questions.explain: “Descargar” = to download and “el móvil” = phone, so “Descargo aplicaciones en mi móvil”.

questions.q: What does “los seguidores” mean on social media?
questions.explain: “Los seguidores” means “followers”, from “seguir” (to follow).
'La pantalla' means 'the screen' (of a phone, TV or computer).
“Grabar” means “to record”, so “grabar un vídeo” = “to record a video”.
“Colgar una foto” means “to post/upload a photo” online (literally “to hang”).

questions.q: Which sentence means 'I went to the cinema yesterday'?
options: Ayer iba al cine a menudo
questions.explain: 'Fui' is the preterite of 'ir' (I went); with 'ayer' the completed past is correct: 'Ayer fui al cine'.

questions.q: Which means “My phone has run out of battery”?
options: Mi móvil se han quedado sin batería
Mi móvil se ha quedado con batería
Mi móvil se ha quedado sin batería
Mi móvil se ha quedado sin señal
questions.explain: “Quedarse sin batería” = “to run out of battery”.
Temporary states use 'estar': 'Estoy cansado'. 'Casado' means married, a near-miss spelling distractor.

questions.q: What does 'una estrella de cine' mean?
questions.explain: 'Una estrella de cine' literally 'a star of cinema' means 'a film star'.
